claim_text: At De libero arbitrio I.11.21 Augustine concludes that nothing else makes the mind a companion of desire except its own will and free choice (propria voluntas et liberum arbitrium). This evidence does not establish that Augustine coined the phrase.

locator.edition_or_witness: Latin corpus text; KG work names Green CSEL 74 / CCSL 29, while final edition-level closure remains required for the work as a whole

notes: The source-level distinction is essential: Augustine makes the will/free-choice claim here; Tertullian Adv. Marc. II.6 supplies an earlier attestation of liberum arbitrium vocabulary.
